children: Korn Ferry provided recast unaudited quarterly fee revenue for fiscal 2026 under its new Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific reporting segments.
Filed Exhibit 99.1 with quarterly unaudited fee revenue recast to new geographic segments for each quarter of fiscal 2026.
Recast disaggregates fee revenue by three Solution groups: Search, Talent & Organizational Solutions, and Workforce Solutions.
Total fee revenue by quarter: $708.6M (Q1), $721.7M (Q2), $717.4M (Q3), $759.8M (Q4) under the new reporting.
Americas accounted for the largest share each quarter (57.0%→58.9%); Search remained the largest Solution group (~39% of fee revenue).
Company states recast is voluntary, not a GAAP restatement, and does not change consolidated GAAP net income, EPS, operating income, or balance sheet items.
